method: Read-only canonical whole-helper inspection plus independently reviewed local structure views.
sample_contract: 14CAC maps one address pointer; 1605C receives sample records and mapped base, returns nonzero only for an existing/added registry entry. The sole 162AC caller gates it on this result. 14CFC is a real two-argument stub called with addresses of descriptor/data pointers; no body is inserted or removed.
state_contract: 1734C walks nodes with native next/previous/identifier at 0/4/8 from heads at F78/F7C. 1FA18 takes one full identifier, returns ignored integer status. 17644 uses the peer-verified 4088-byte record view from routing commit 78469c93, ID+0 and inactive+4033.
evidence_caveat: Existing predecessor type/source bytes remain frozen. New native F78 pointer evidence refines a previously opaque field only in this packet. Source names are descriptive hypotheses.
